bounded_contract.scope: Original unchanged scalar helper and its unchanged direct predicate caller, all u32 inputs; not complete float formatting callers.
bounded_contract.normal_value: For value>0, helper returns the unique k in [0,13] for which 5^k divides value and 5^(k+1) does not. Caller returns k>=p for every u32 p.
bounded_contract.zero: With selected debug assertions, value=0 panics before division/remainder or count mutation, for every p, including p=0. No fabricated return.
bounded_contract.termination: For positive value, every backedge sets value=value/5 with zero remainder and increments count once. Ranking value strictly decreases, remains positive, and at most13 backedges precede the exiting iteration (at most14 iterations).
bounded_contract.effects: Scalar Copy locals only; no heap, reference, alias, destructor or external effect. Assertion panic remains an explicit exceptional outcome.
bounded_contract.evaluation_order: At each iteration assertion precedes q=value/5, r=value%5 and break condition; division/remainder use the same saved iteration value. Exit does not update value/count. Caller evaluates both input arguments once in source order, invokes helper once, and compares only its normal return.
